enforced_by: the frameworks' sections; the copywriter's expansion

rows.name: Hook
rows.what: The point of entry. One job: force the next beat to be watched. Its content is set by the awareness level and the sophistication stage, not by taste.

rows.name: Problem
rows.what: The need named and felt, described in enough specific detail that the audience recognises its own situation before anything is offered.

rows.name: Failed solutions
rows.what: The alternatives already tried, each failing at a moment the audience recognises — every named weakness answered immediately by the matching strength.

rows.name: Root cause
rows.what: The real reason the problem persists, reframed so it is a different problem than the audience thought, and reached by steps already accepted.

rows.name: Unique mechanism
rows.what: How the product produces the result — named, described or featured, at the depth the market's sophistication stage demands. At stage 3 and above the mechanism leads.

rows.name: Solution
rows.what: The product in action and the desire fulfilled, stretched across time, carrying the role the audience wants to be seen in.

rows.name: Product
rows.what: What the thing actually is — the physical facts, used only to justify price, document quality, promise durability or sharpen the picture, never as the lead sell.

rows.name: Offer
rows.what: The terms: price set against a bigger anchor, and the guarantee restating every promise as the final intensification beat.

rows.name: Call to action
rows.what: The conclusion of the accepted-step chain — the single step still left once every prior step has been agreed to.

rows.name: Identification
rows.what: Who this is for. The call-out that names the viewer to themselves — their situation, their role, their words — before any problem is stated or anything is offered. At unaware this is the only opening allowed; everywhere else it is the beat that earns the right to name the problem.

rows.name: Agitation
rows.what: The stakes. What it costs to leave the problem alone, and the future that arrives if nothing changes — the black side of the picture, reached one already-accepted step at a time rather than asserted.

rows.name: Proof
rows.what: Evidence placed at the beat where doubt peaks, never front-loaded because it happens to be proof: results, testimonials, authority, demonstration, before and after — and written as selling copy, dramatic and specific, not as a dry fact block.

rows.name: Transformation
rows.what: The after. The fulfilled desire pictured — the first-use moment lived, the benefit stretched across weeks and months, and the role the viewer gets to be seen playing once it has happened.

rows.name: Objections
rows.what: The flinch answered. The specific reasons not to buy — named in the viewer's own words — redefined or resolved before the ask, never after it.

rows.name: Urgency
rows.what: Why now. The reason to act in this moment rather than later — real and receipted: a dated deal, a real limit, a cost that compounds. Invented scarcity is never this section.
